task.question: Which anime series won Anime of the Year at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards?
task.evidence: The most recent ceremony was the 10th ceremony, held on May 23, 2026, where the eighth and final season of My Hero Academia won the Anime of the Year award.

answer:
The anime series that won Anime of the Year at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards is the eighth and final season of My Hero Academia. 

FINAL: My Hero Academia (eighth and final season)
